name: audit.py
summary: Central audit-trail module providing before/after change-logging helper functions for every mutable entity type in the SoA workbench (visits, activities, elements, timings, schedule timelines, instances, amendments, organizations, roles, persons, and more), each writing a row to the entity's audit table using the supplied database cursor.

name: activities.py
summary: FastAPI router for Activity CRUD, bulk creation, and reordering, plus CDISC Biomedical Concept fetching/association and the DSS (Dataset Specialization) and CRF specialization cell rendering used by the SoA matrix UI.

name: bc_surrogates.py
summary: FastAPI router managing BC (Biomedical Concept) Surrogate entities and their links to activities, including the concepts-cell HTMX partial that renders surrogate/BC assignments in the SoA matrix.

name: cells.py
summary: FastAPI router for StudyCell CRUD (arm/epoch/element junction entities) and cell reordering, backing the API and HTMX UI endpoints of the SoA design matrix.

name: condition_assignments.py
summary: FastAPI router for ConditionAssignment CRUD, mapping decision-instance branch conditions to their target instances, with matching API and HTMX UI endpoints.

name: decision_instances.py
summary: FastAPI router for DecisionInstance CRUD and reordering — the branch points in a ScheduleTimeline that route subjects based on ConditionAssignments.

name: elements.py
summary: FastAPI router for StudyElement CRUD (structural design periods/cohorts), transition-rule and study-intervention associations, and the element audit-history endpoint.

name: footnotes.py
summary: FastAPI router for Footnote CRUD used to annotate SoA matrix cells and activities with reference text.

name: instances.py
summary: FastAPI router for ScheduledActivityInstance CRUD and reordering — the temporal visit/timepoint occurrences within a ScheduleTimeline.

name: persons.py
summary: FastAPI router for Person CRUD plus role/organization assignment-conflict validation, backing the combined Organizations/Roles/Persons UI page.

name: rules.py
summary: FastAPI router for transition-rule (reusable business-rule text) CRUD used as start/end rule references by elements and visits.

name: schedule_timelines.py
summary: FastAPI router for ScheduleTimeline CRUD (main/branch timeline containers) plus the consolidated Study Timing overview page aggregating instances, decision instances, timings, and condition assignments.

name: study_identifiers.py
summary: FastAPI router for StudyIdentifier CRUD, linking scoping organizations to study identifier values such as the NCT number.

name: timings.py
summary: FastAPI router for StudyTiming CRUD, including ISO 8601 duration/window validation and relative-to-instance scheduling used to compute visit timing windows.

name: visits.py
summary: FastAPI router for Visit (Encounter) CRUD, reordering, transition rules, and environmental-setting/contact-mode code-list associations.

name: schemas.py
summary: Central Pydantic request-validation schema module defining Create/Update payload models for every mutable USDM entity in the application (activities, elements, visits, timings, arms, epochs, amendments, and more), including ISO 8601 duration and timing-window consistency validators.

name: app.py
summary: Main FastAPI application module: defines the app instance, lifespan startup (DB init + sequential schema migrations), CDISC Library concept/specialization fetch-and-cache endpoints, SoA matrix build/render logic, and the bulk of the SoA edit page's inline UI endpoints (cells, superscripts, elements, transition rules) plus XLSX/HTML/PDF/CSV export.

name: db.py
summary: Canonical SQLite connection helper used throughout the web app; resolves the DB path (auto-selecting the test DB under pytest) and opens a connection with WAL mode and a busy timeout.

name: initialize_database.py
summary: Defines `_init_db`, a single large function that creates every core SQLite table (studies, arms, epochs, visits, activities, cells, timelines, instances, audits, and related entities) on a fresh database.

name: migrate_database.py
summary: Library of ~108 small, idempotent schema-migration functions (new columns, new tables, audit tables, backfills, data repairs) that are individually imported and invoked by `app.py`'s lifespan startup to incrementally evolve the SQLite schema across releases.

name: _freeze_helpers.py
summary: Core implementation behind the SoA freeze/versioning system: captures point-in-time snapshots of every study entity (arms, timings, objectives, endpoints, encounters, cells, timelines, instances, BCs, amendments), computes structural diffs between two freezes, and performs freeze rollback.

name: amendments.py
summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for protocol amendments and their sub-entities (secondary reasons, impacts, changes with document-content-reference sections, geographic scopes, subject enrollments, governance dates), each tied to a freeze.

name: audits.py
summary: FastAPI router rendering a single combined audit-trail history page that aggregates before/after change records across every auditable entity type in a SoA.

name: bc_categories.py
summary: FastAPI router for assigning and removing CDISC BC (Biomedical Concept) classification categories on an activity, expanding a category into its constituent concepts on assignment.

name: dair.py
summary: FastAPI router serving the Digital Amendment Impact Report (DAIR) UI page and its downloadable DOCX report comparing a base and revised freeze.

name: freezes.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing the freeze lifecycle (list, create with optional amendment metadata, view, diff, rollback, delete) as thin HTTP endpoints over `_freeze_helpers` and `amendments` internals.

name: organizations.py
summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for study Organization entities, including organization-type and country controlled-terminology code management and structured address fields.

name: roles.py
summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for study Role entities, including role-type controlled-terminology codes, organization linkage, person assignment, masking flags, and conflict validation between role/org/person combinations.

name: soa_bundle.py
summary: FastAPI router for exporting and importing an entire SoA study as a self-contained JSON bundle covering all related tables, enabling backup, cloning, or transfer of a study between databases.

name: usdm_json.py
summary: FastAPI router serving generated USDM JSON, the Define-JSON view, and per-component USDM downloads for a SoA, delegating actual generation to the `usdm` package's generators.

name: cdash_terminology.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached CDASH Controlled Terminology package sourced from the CDISC Library, with search, code/codelist filtering, and pagination.

name: ddf_controlled_terminology.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached DDF (Digital Data Flow) Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

name: define_xml_terminology.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached Define-XML Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

name: concept_groups.py
summary: Large FastAPI router managing custom Concept Groups (CRUD on groups, member concepts, category/surrogate assignment to activities) and a proxy/sync layer to the external BC Grouping microservice that materializes CDISC classification schemes as concept_group rows (source='cdisc') alongside user-authored custom groups.

name: estimands.py
summary: FastAPI router providing full CRUD for USDM Estimands within a SoA: estimand records, their outcome/endpoint variables, intercurrent events and handling strategies, and associated study interventions, with both JSON API and HTMX UI endpoints.

name: indications.py
summary: FastAPI router providing full CRUD for USDM Indications within a SoA, including disease/condition coding (code system, version, decode), with both JSON API and HTMX UI endpoints. Its `_list_indications` helper is reused by the estimands router.

name: protocol_controlled_terminology.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached ICH M11 Protocol Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

name: rollback.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing JSON, HTMX, and XLSX-export views over the rollback and reorder audit trails maintained by the app module, letting users inspect and export the history of freeze rollbacks and drag-and-drop reordering actions for a SoA.

name: sdtm_terminology.py
summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached SDTM Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

name: tdd.py
summary: FastAPI router generating SDTM Trial Design Domains (TA/Trial Arms, TE/Trial Elements, TV/Trial Visits) from the SoA's arms, elements, and visits, exposing JSON dataset views, a define-XML style column metadata browser page, and CSV download.

name: utils.py
summary: Large shared utility module for the web layer: CDISC Library API integration (cached fetch/refresh of epoch types, environmental settings, contact modes, and SDTM/CDASH/Define-XML/Protocol/DDF Controlled Terminology packages), monotonic UID generators for dozens of USDM entity types, USDM/database lookup helpers (timing, encounters, epochs, schedule timelines), and misc helpers (ISO-8601 duration parsing, referer-based redirects).

name: codelist_config.py
summary: Defines CDISC controlled-terminology codelist code constants (epoch type, arm type, role type, objective/endpoint level, intervention role/type/unit, etc.) that back UI dropdowns, each overridable via a CODELIST_* environment variable in config.env.

name: arms.py
summary: FastAPI router providing API and HTMX UI endpoints for managing Study Arms (StudyArm USDM entity): create/list/update/delete, arm reordering, and CDISC CT-backed arm type / data-origin type coding.

name: endpoints.py
summary: FastAPI router managing Endpoint entities linked to Study Objectives, exposing API and HTMX UI create/update/delete endpoints with CDISC CT-backed endpoint-level coding.

name: epochs.py
summary: FastAPI router for managing Study Epochs (StudyEpoch USDM entity): CRUD, epoch-type coding via CDISC CT, epoch metadata updates, and drag-and-drop reordering, with an internal per-field audit-trail helper.

name: objectives.py
summary: FastAPI router managing Study Objectives (Objective USDM entity) together with their linked Endpoints, providing API and HTMX UI CRUD endpoints and CDISC CT-backed objective/endpoint level coding.

name: study_interventions.py
summary: FastAPI router managing Study Interventions (StudyIntervention USDM entity), including role/type/dose coding across multiple CDISC CT packages (DDF, Protocol, SDTM) and per-intervention CT code/alias sub-entities.

name: study_titles.py
summary: FastAPI router managing Study Titles (StudyTitle USDM entity) with CDISC CT-backed title-type coding, exposing both JSON API and HTMX UI create/delete endpoints.

name: __init__.py
summary: Package entry point for soa_builder that re-exports the core legacy pipeline functions (normalize_soa, expand_schedule_rules, validate_imaging_schedule) as the public API via __all__.

name: cli.py
summary: Click-based command-line interface exposing normalize, expand, and validate subcommands that drive the legacy SoA CSV normalization, schedule-rule expansion, and imaging validation pipeline.

name: normalization.py
summary: Parses a wide-format SoA CSV into normalized dataclasses (Visit, Activity, VisitActivity, ActivityCategory, ScheduleRule) and writes them to per-entity CSVs and a SQLite database for downstream schedule expansion.

name: schedule.py
summary: Expands normalized schedule rules (cyclical, weekly, daily patterns) into concrete projected activity occurrences across a study horizon, given a start date and cycle configuration.

name: validation.py
summary: Extracts imaging-related visit/activity events from normalized rows and validates that consecutive imaging events fall within an expected interval tolerance, used by the CLI validate command.

summary: Partial template rendering the create form and editable table for Condition Assignments within a schedule timeline, including inline decision-instance and target-instance selectors.

name: _decision_instances_section.html
summary: Partial template providing the create form and editable table for Decision Instances, letting users set default condition, epoch, and timeline membership for each decision point.

name: _instances_section.html

name: _schedule_timelines_section.html
summary: Partial template with the create form and editable table for Schedule Timelines, capturing timeline metadata such as the main-timeline flag, entry condition, and entry/exit points.

name: _timings_section.html
summary: Partial template for managing Timing entities (relative-from/relative-to activity instances, ISO-8601 duration values and windows), with client-side JavaScript enforcing that window lower/upper/label fields are all filled when any one is provided.

name: amendment_changes_partial.html

name: base.html

name: bc_explorer.html
summary: Self-contained CDISC BC Grouping Explorer widget: a large embedded CSS design-token stylesheet plus HTML shell (search bar, facet sidebar, card grid/browse views, detail panel) that boots client-side via bc_explorer.js from a server-supplied JSON data payload.

name: bc_status.html
summary: Tiny status-notice partial showing whether the BC Grouping Service API connection is healthy or in error, used for inline connectivity feedback.

summary: HTMX partial status badge indicating whether the CDISC Library API is connected, missing a key, erroring, or running in offline mode.

summary: Detail page listing the biomedical concepts that belong to a single CDISC concept category, with links to each concept's detail page.

name: concept_detail.html
summary: Detail page for a single CDISC Library biomedical concept, showing its summary attributes, parent BC/package links, data element concepts table, and raw JSON.

name: concept_groups.html
summary: Page for managing global custom biomedical concept groups (create, edit, delete, assign concepts/surrogates/CDISC categories) alongside a lazy-loaded CDISC BC Groupings explorer widget.

name: concepts_cell.html
summary: SoA activity-matrix table-cell partial for assigning and removing biomedical concepts, concept groups, CDISC categories, and BC surrogates on an activity, with inline bulk-edit mode.

name: concepts_list.html
summary: Lists all CDISC Library biomedical concepts with a client-side search filter and links to each concept's detail page and related SDTM Dataset Specializations.

summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the condition assignments section partial.

summary: DDF (Digital Data Flow) controlled terminology browser page with a multi-field filter form, paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

name: decision_instances.html

name: edit.html

name: element_audit_section.html

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker file that makes soa_builder.mcp a Python package for the MCP server module.

name: server.py
summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing 11 tools over stdio for interacting with the SoA workbench: listing/creating SoAs, visits, and activities, assigning activities to scheduled instances, retrieving the visits-by-activities matrix, and generating USDM/Define-JSON documents. Registered as the `soa-mcp` console script and picked up by Claude Code via `.mcp.json`.

name: bc_explorer.js
summary: Client-side script driving the CDISC Biomedical Concept (BC) Grouping Explorer UI: filters and renders BC cards/matrix views by scheme facets and search query, and manages a detail panel showing related concepts. Consumes a server-seeded global `BC_DATA` object rather than fetching or importing data itself.

name: bc_groupings.html
summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page explaining Biomedical Concept Groupings: how groups tag related BCs, are created at the UX layer independent of any single SoA, can be assigned to or removed from an Activity, and support copy/inheritance between groups.

name: bc_workflow.html
summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page walking through the workflow for linking a Biomedical Concept (and Biomedical Concept Surrogate) to an Activity/Scheduled Activity Instance in the SoA Matrix, illustrated with screenshots.

name: style.css
summary: Shared design-system stylesheet for the whole soa-workbench web UI, defining the `am-` (atomic utility) and `fz-` (freeze/component) class conventions used across templates: layout grids, form controls, buttons, data tables, change/audit cards, and spacing/typography utilities.

name: usdm_json.html
summary: Jinja template rendering the USDM JSON generation page for a study: a table of downloadable USDM components (arms, activities, encounters, etc.) each linking to its component-specific JSON download endpoint.

name: usdm_model_explorer.html
summary: Self-contained interactive USDM v4.0.0 Model Explorer page embedding the full USDM class/attribute reference data inline as a JSON literal (sourced from dataStructure.yml, USDM_UML.xmi, USDM_API JSON, USDM_CT.xlsx, and the LZZT pilot study), with its own browse/search UI and scoped styling independent of the shared app stylesheet.
